name: v5.2.9
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 5.2.x -->

## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes 🐞
* Release the body a filter cannot bind and reject such filter bodies at compile time by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13498
* Flush the window update when the HTTP/2 client resumes a backpressured response by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13487
* Do not chunk a streamed response to an HTTP/1.0 client by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13503
* Python: do not let a non-scope module decorator cost a module its pooling by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13488
### Other Changes 💡
* Limit the JaCoCo agent to the Micronaut classes by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13483
* Compile Kotlin test sources without the Kotlin compiler and KSP on the classpath by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13480
* Keep the inject-kotlin test forks for the whole run by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13485
* Skip publishing to the local Maven repository in the JVM and native CI builds by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13484
* Keep the inject-groovy and http-netty test forks for the whole run by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13486
* Initialize Netty's TypeParameterMatcher at run time in native images by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13492
* Keep the http-server-netty test forks for the whole run by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13495
* Pass a null argument to a Python callable converted to Function by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13490
* Cut the CPU of the Python CI: no Truffle compilation, C2 host JIT, balanced shards by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13496
* Give up on a dead connection within seconds in CI by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13497
* Fix the flaky MaxResponseSizeDiscardSpec and ContextURISpec by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13491
* Compile the test and build JVMs with C2 instead of the Graal JIT by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13489
* Split the Python CI across two jobs instead of four by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13510
* Make the MalformedUri filter feature independent of feature order by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13499


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/compare/v5.2.8...v5.2.9
